sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V.Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.6638 of 2020
Order:

The petitioner claims to be the absolute owner and possessor of land admeasuring Ac.0.31 guntas in Survey No.1075 of Wanaparthy Village, Mandal and District, having acquired the same from his father through Registered Gift Deed dated 19.12.2003.

It is the case of the petitioner that his father initially established a Saw Mill in the schedule property and later on the petitioner established a Petrol Pump in the year 2016 by obtaining necessary permission from the statutory authorities.

The grievance of the petitioner is that the respondents, with an intention to widen the existing 60 feet road to 100 feet road, has marked the portion of the subject land of the petitioner for the purpose of road widening that too without initiating any proceedings under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and there is a threat of demolition of the petitioner's property without following due procedure prescribed by law.
This Court, while admitting the writ petition on 01.05.2020, has granted interim direction to the respondents not to undertake demolition of the subject property without following due process of law.
Learned counsel appearing for the respondents submit that the respondents have not taken up any programme for road widening purpose and in the event the petitioner's land is required for the purpose of road widening, they will follow due procedure of law.
In view of the aforesaid submission, the writ petition is disposed of directing that if the subject property of the petitioner is required for the purpose of road widening, the respondents shall follow the procedure as prescribed under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
